DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_FlowerPrince:
Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil.
What it protects, and for what purpose, <characterName id=|FlowerPrince|/> does not care.
After all, the World Tree knows everything.
Only the mist it wields can reveal the truth.

Condenses its mist into <itemName id=|Corrosive_Solvent| style=|Status_Keyword|/> when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_FlowerPrince:
When activated, 
the player's attacks inflict <uiCommon id=|ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Poison| style=|Effect_Poison|/> <Status_Up>{ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}</>.

While in party, 
grants the player and party Pals immunity to <uiCommon id=|ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Poison| style=|Effect_Poison|/>, and <Status_Keyword>nullifies the effects of toxic gas</> in the World Tree area. 
(Does not stack)

Condenses its mist into <itemName id=|Corrosive_Solvent| style=|Status_Keyword|/> when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
